species.name: Crappie
why: Water 63°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 8–28 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 45 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 65 ft, so fish stay above it.

species.name: White bass
why: Water 63°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 10–28 ft deep, mostly on wind-blown banks.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 45 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 65 ft, so fish stay above it.
North wind at 10 mph pushes bait onto the south shore: try the wind-blown banks.

North wind at 10 mph pushes bait onto the south shore: try the wind-blown banks.
